verdict.rationale: PayPal has its own automation features, such as automated payment recovery for subscriptions, automatic invoice reminders, the Disputes API and an agent toolkit with an MCP server. So asking whether those automations can be versioned and rolled back is a fair question, and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review/approval workflows, change history or rollback for any automation, agent configuration or rule set. Voiding authorizations and refunds are payment reversals, not automation rollback, so they earn no credit.
